user.permission.catalog.read: See the catalog: products, attributes, options, product types, brands, categories, prices and stock
user.permission.catalog.write: Change the catalog, prices and stock
user.permission.catalog.publish: Publish, unpublish, archive and restore products
user.permission.users.manage: Manage admin users: create them, change roles, deactivate and activate them, reset passwords
user.permission.orders.write: Mark orders paid or fulfilled, and cancel orders
user.permission.customers.write: Deactivate, activate and unlock customer accounts
user.permission.shipping.manage: Manage shipping methods, rates and carrier settings
user.permission.email.manage: Manage email delivery: see the status and sent mails with their recipients, send a test, resend or cancel a mail, preview templates
user.password.hint: {min} to {max} characters, not the user's email address. No other rules.
user.password.generatedNote: A random password is in the field and shown once. Copy it now: after saving it is not shown again.
user.dialog.selfCheck: I understand that this changes my own account.
user.list.intro: Only owners see this area. Roles are fixed; each role's permissions are listed when you create a user or change a role.
user.list.caption: Admin users
user.list.pastEnd: There are no users on this page.
user.list.emptyBody: The list is empty. Create an owner on the server with pnpm admin:create.
user.create.emailHint: The user signs in with it. It is stored in lower case and cannot be changed later.
user.create.emailTaken: Another admin user already has this email address.
user.create.handoverHint: No email is sent. You hand the password over to the user yourself, outside this admin, and they change it under Your account.
user.create.unknownReading: The answer did not arrive. Reading the list of users…
user.create.unknown.found: A user with this email is stored now. It may have been created by this request or by someone else. The password you typed was cleared: if the user cannot sign in, reset their password on their page.
user.create.unknown.absent: No user with this email is stored. Nothing was created; type a password and create the user again.
user.create.unknown.notChecked: The list is too long to check every user here. Open the list of users before you create the user again.
user.create.unknown.unreadable: The list of users could not be read. Open the list before you create the user again.
user.created.title: Admin user created
user.created.passwordNotShown: The password is not shown again.
user.created.handover: No email is sent: hand the password over to the user yourself, outside this admin (in person or by a channel you trust).
user.created.changeIt: Ask the user to change the password under Your account after the first sign-in.
user.detail.title: Admin user
user.detail.selfBody: Changing your own role or deactivating yourself can lock you out of this area or of the admin. The server always keeps at least one active owner and refuses otherwise.
user.role.title: Role
user.role.hint: A role change applies from the user's next request; their sessions stay.
user.role.unchanged: Choose another role to change it.
user.activity.title: Access
user.activity.deactivateHint: Deactivating ends all of the user's sessions at once and refuses their sign-in until the account is activated again. Nothing else is deleted.
user.activity.activateHint: Activating lets the user sign in again with their password. Their earlier sessions are not restored.
user.reset.title: Password
user.reset.hint: Set a new password for this user. It ends all of their sessions and clears their sign-in lock. You hand it over yourself; no email is sent.
user.reset.hintSelf: Set a new password for your own account. It ends all of your sessions, this one too, and clears the sign-in lock.
user.roleDialog.title: Change the role?
user.roleDialog.nextRequest: The change applies from the user's next request. Their sessions stay.
user.roleDialog.lastOwner: The server refuses to take the owner role from the last active owner.
user.deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate this user?
user.deactivateDialog.sessions: All of their sessions end at once and they cannot sign in until an owner activates the account again. The account itself is kept.
user.deactivateDialog.lastOwner: The server refuses to deactivate the last active owner.
user.resetDialog.title: Set a new password?
user.resetDialog.body: The password of {email} will be replaced.
user.resetDialog.sessions: ALL of the user's sessions end at once and their sign-in lock is cleared.
user.resetDialog.handover: Hand the new password over to the user yourself; no email is sent.
user.self.losesUsersArea: This is your own account: with this role you can no longer manage admin users, from your next request on.
user.self.signedOutCannotSignIn: This is your own account: your session here ends at once and you cannot sign in again until another owner activates you.
user.self.signedOutSignInAgain: This is your own account: your session here ends too. The admin then asks you to sign in again; use the new password.
user.refusal.last_owner_cannot_be_demote: Refused: this is the last active owner, so the role stays owner. Make another user an owner first, then change this role.
user.refusal.last_owner_cannot_be_deacti: Refused: this is the last active owner, so the account stays active. Make another user an owner first, then deactivate this one.
user.notice.done.changeRole: Role changed. It applies from the user's next request.
user.notice.done.deactivate: User deactivated. All of their sessions ended.
user.notice.done.activate: User activated. They can sign in again.
user.notice.done.resetPassword: New password set. All of the user's sessions ended and their sign-in lock was cleared. Hand the password over yourself.
user.notice.done.resetPasswordSelf: Your new password is set and all your sessions ended, this one too. Sign in again with the new password when asked.
user.notice.unknownReading: The answer did not arrive. Reading the user again…
user.notice.unknown.roleChanged: The stored role is now {role}. This may come from your request or from someone else.
user.notice.unknown.roleUnchanged: The stored role is still {role}. Change it again if you still want to.
user.notice.unknown.now_deactivated: The user is stored as deactivated now.
user.notice.unknown.still_active: The user is still stored as active. Deactivate again if you still want to.
user.notice.unknown.now_active: The user is stored as active now.
user.notice.unknown.still_deactivated: The user is still stored as deactivated. Activate again if you still want to.
user.notice.unknown.password_unknown: The stored user does not show whether the password changed. If the new password does not work, set it again.
user.notice.unknown.unreadable: The user could not be read again. Reload the page to see what is stored.
